generic_public_replay_qualification: Earlier v3 and v4 public replay logs are byte-identical and their manifests do not by themselves bind the package supplied. Their separately retained builders and full replays record the distinct invocations; the later projection replay manifest explicitly binds its package.
source_group_control_qualification: The source group encrypted an earlier 18-file control snapshot. Its later 102-file post-build control and scan candidate/correction chain are included in this group.
post_cutoff: The subsequently created source-group metadata-binding control and its public binding and scan are outside this group and require separate custody. The later application candidate and q689 are outside this cutoff.
recovery_dependencies: This group needs the separately held same-machine key; prior ciphertext groups, original and reconstructed history, source archives, Git objects and nested keys remain separate as applicable. The encrypted control snapshot contains only its named pre-build files; full later control and restoration outputs remain separately held.
limits: Same-machine authenticated restore and finite metadata scans do not establish independent custody, full history, checkpoint 3821, product behavior or audit closure.
